# Wllama 3.8.1

`index.mjs` and `wllama.wasm` are unmodified compiled assets from the official
`@wllama/wllama@3.8.1` npm package (the JavaScript file was renamed from `esm/index.js`).
License: MIT, included as `LICENCE`.
Source: https://github.com/ngxson/wllama
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@wllama/wllama/-/wllama-3.8.1.tgz

These are trusted application runtime assets, independent of discovered plugins.
The browser loads them from the same site only when a user loads a local model.
